WHAT WE REQUIRE - Strong coding skills with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages, such as Javascript, C++, Python, Rust, or similar languages. - Strong engineering prowess, ideally developed at start-ups. - Familiarity with storage and data processing systems, cloud infrastructure, and other technical tools. - Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to iterate quickly with teammates, incorporating feedback and holding a high bar for quality.
